title: Key events in Admin
path: Admin > Data display > Events > Key events tab
steps: In the Google Merchandise Store property, open Admin (the gear icon at the bottom left).
Open the Events area of Admin.
Open the Key events tab. Every event listed there is a key event; a star marks a key event.
Note every key event. If one is not among the options, write its name in the note. Viewer access shows this list but cannot mark or unmark an event.

parts.question: Which events are marked as key events in this property? Tick every one you see.
Is purchase marked as a key event?
In which GA4 menu does someone with edit access mark an event as a key event?
options: Admin > Data collection and modification > Data retention
